name: Taiwan

fees.name: Visitor Visa - Single Entry (overseas application)
fees.validity: 3 months from issue, stay up to 90 days depending on nationality
fees.applies: nationals requiring a visa, applying at a Taiwan overseas mission
fees.notes: Fee is NT$1,600 if applied for inside Taiwan; US$50 if applied for overseas. Official currency for overseas applications is USD per BOCA fee schedule.

fees.name: Visitor Visa - Multiple Entry (overseas application)
fees.validity: up to 3 years depending on nationality, stay up to 90 days per entry
fees.applies: nationals requiring a visa, applying at a Taiwan overseas mission
fees.notes: Fee is NT$3,200 if applied for inside Taiwan; US$100 if applied for overseas.

fees.name: eVisa (online visitor visa)
fees.validity: typically 3 months from issue, stay per visa type
fees.applies: eligible nationalities per BOCA eVisa program
fees.notes: NT$1,600 base fee plus NT$46 online credit-card processing fee = NT$1,646 total. Citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina, Colombia, Haiti, Mauritius, Montenegro, Panama, Peru, and Turkiye receive eVisas free of charge.

fees.name: Visa-on-arrival surcharge
fees.applies: eligible nationalities applying for a visa on arrival at a Taiwan port of entry
fees.notes: Additional charge of NT$800 or US$24 on top of the applicable visa-type fee, per Article 4 of the BOCA visa fee schedule.

free_visa_notes: Taiwan operates a broad visa-exemption program (visa-free entry, typically 14-90 days depending on nationality) for many countries including most of the EU, USA, UK, Canada, Japan, Korea, Australia, and others; those travellers pay no visa fee. Fees above apply only to nationals who require a visa. BOCA's fee schedule references a general reciprocity clause (extra charge equal to what a country charges Taiwanese passport holders) but does not publish a country-by-country reciprocity fee table, so no verified per-nationality amounts (e.g. for IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD, RUS, CAN) could be confirmed from an official source; reciprocity_variations left empty rather than guessed. Taiwan is not a Schengen member. No VFS/outsourced visa centre network was found for Taiwan visa applications; visas are processed directly by Taiwan's overseas missions (Taipei Economic and Cultural Offices) or via the official eVisa portal.
